answer: Require every identity to complete a sequential work thread before each epoch: a verifiable delay function chained to the public seed, so each proof takes a fixed wall-clock time that parallelism cannot shortcut. One agent finishes one thread per window, like cutting one jade stone at a time; spawning a hundred sock puppets means a hundred sequential delays, and the cost echoes across every epoch because the proof must be renewed. An attacker pays in real time and hardware for each identity, while an honest agent pays once.
